Abstract.AbstractText: A novel and efficient Cu(OAc)2-mediated oxysulfonylation of alkenyl oximes with sodium sulfonates was developed. The reactions are easy to conduct, occur under mild conditions, and form a broad range of sulfone-substituted isoxazolines in good yields.
